user_saw: Running `desktop-browser-smoke` without a machine-class override reserved a `beast` machine for a screenshot and short recording.
summary: The fix defaults Mantis desktop browser smoke to `tiny` while preserving explicit and environment overrides.
reasoning: The September refactor moved the existing `beast` default into the shared resolver, and the October refactor preserved that default when it moved option resolution into session creation. The previous documentation specified `beast`, and the PR reports successful captures on smaller machines without identifying a failure on `beast`, so this was a change in resource allocation policy.
